lines.zh: 钟响了，我得赶去会合点
lines.en: The bell rang, I must reach the meeting point.

lines.zh: 这条去麦田的路我走了一百遍
lines.en: I have walked this path to the wheat fields a hundred times.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在口袋里，走路都沉
lines.en: Emeralds in my pocket make every step heavier.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡在看着，我走得慢一点
lines.en: The iron golem is watching, so I walk slower.

lines.zh: 磨坊的面粉味，今天风向对
lines.en: The mill smells of flour, the wind is right today.
Do not step on my farmland, go around it.

lines.zh: 我得赶在天黑前回到床上
lines.en: I need to reach my bed before nightfall.

lines.zh: 图书馆那扇门，永远关不严
lines.en: The library door never shuts all the way.
Who is ringing the bell so urgently?

lines.zh: 我背着全村的账本去集市
lines.en: I carry the whole village ledger to the market.

lines.zh: 僵尸村的方向，我一步不去
lines.en: I will not take one step toward the zombie village.

lines.zh: 石板路被羊踩乱了，真烦
lines.en: Sheep have scattered the stones, how annoying.

lines.zh: 会合点的篝火该添柴了
lines.en: The meeting point fire needs more wood.

lines.zh: 柜台前排队的人该等急了
lines.en: The queue at my counter must be impatient.

lines.zh: 今天的萝卜收成，勉强够换一颗绿宝石
lines.en: Today's carrots barely buy me a single emerald.

lines.zh: 我数了三遍库存，还是少一块面包
lines.en: I counted stock three times, still one bread short.
Someone has moved my workbench.

lines.zh: 图书馆的书又被雨打湿了
lines.en: The library books got wet in the rain again.
The bread oven needs more coal.

lines.zh: 这村子安静得让我不安
lines.en: This village is too quiet, it unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我的职业牌还挂在门口
lines.en: My profession sign still hangs by the door.
Who was knocking on my window at midnight?

lines.zh: 铁傀儡今天换了新的藤蔓
lines.en: The golem wore fresh vines today.

lines.zh: 我记得每一笔没结清的账
lines.en: I remember every debt still unpaid.

lines.zh: 那块南瓜地是我亲手翻的
lines.en: I turned that pumpkin field with my own hands.

lines.zh: 有张床空着，主人没回来
lines.en: One bed stands empty, its owner never returned.
The rope on the bell is about to snap.

lines.zh: 我闻到雨要来了，得收麦子
lines.en: I smell rain coming, I must bring in the wheat.

lines.zh: 你身上有绿宝石的味道
lines.en: You smell of emeralds to me.

lines.zh: 第一次见你这样打扮的客人
lines.en: First time I see a customer dressed like you.
Stop staring at my counter.

lines.zh: 你是来交易，还是来问路
lines.en: Are you here to trade or to ask directions?

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了远方的泥
lines.en: Your boots carry mud from somewhere far.
I have memorized your face, customer.
Stand back, I need to tidy my shelves.
Put away that sword in your hand.

lines.zh: 村里没人在这个点出门
lines.en: Nobody in this village leaves home at this hour.
Your pocket bulges suspiciously.
I guess you came from the north.

lines.zh: 交易要讲规矩，先看完价
lines.en: Trade has rules, look at the price first.
You are blocking the light of my stall.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像会种地的人
lines.en: You do not look like someone who farms.
Keep your hands off my shelves

lines.zh: 这个点来的客人不多见
lines.en: We do not often get visitors at this hour
Ah, my robe is torn.
Not the face, I still have deals to make.
A cleric should look at this wound.
My emeralds are scattered across the ground.

lines.zh: 你们村就是这么待客的
lines.en: So this is how your village treats guests.
That hit just cost me a whole day's work.
Whoever threw that, step forward.

lines.zh: 我要关门了，今天不营业
lines.en: I am closing up, no business today.

lines.zh: 我早说过这条路不安全
lines.en: I told you this road was not safe.
The doctor's fee comes out of your account.

lines.zh: 那颗绿宝石，我能摸一下吗
lines.en: May I touch that emerald for a moment?
Bread for it, I offer three loaves.

lines.zh: 你把绿宝石举那么高做什么
lines.en: Why hold the emerald up so high?

lines.zh: 我摊子上有你要的东西
lines.en: My stall has exactly what you want.
Stop waving it, my eyes are spinning.

lines.zh: 这价钱我们可以慢慢谈
lines.en: We can discuss this price slowly.

lines.zh: 我认得成色好的绿宝石
lines.en: I know a fine emerald when I see one.
A pumpkin will do as payment too.

lines.zh: 我口袋里正好有你要的
lines.en: I happen to have what you want in my pocket.
Name your price, I will not haggle.
Hey, watch the road, I am carrying soup.
You spill a basket of carrots, you pay.
My shelf nearly toppled over.
Let me pass, do not block the doorway.
You are standing on my robe.

lines.zh: 集市的路不是你一个人的
lines.en: The market road is not yours alone.
Careful, I am holding eggs here.

lines.zh: 这个宽度过不去两个人
lines.en: Two people cannot pass through this width.
Make way, the bell is about to ring.
Push again and the emeralds will drop.

lines.zh: 今晚月亮好，孩子们该睡了
lines.en: The moon is nice tonight, the children should sleep.
My partner is counting beds again.

lines.zh: 院子里很快会有小孩跑
lines.en: Soon children will run in this yard.
We must build a proper bed first.
This village needs more hands.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最大的面包
lines.en: I saved the largest loaf for her.
This feeling rings like a small bell.
Would you move in next door to me?
Our child will inherit my profession.
Lower your voice, the neighbors can hear.

lines.zh: 这块面包掉在地上，归我
lines.en: This bread fell on the ground, it is mine.

lines.zh: 谁掉的绿宝石，我先收着
lines.en: Someone dropped an emerald, I will hold it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，回头交给村长
lines.en: I pick it up and hand it to the chief later.
That seed on the ground is worth planting.
This one is for my child.
Found items must be recorded.
Do not grab it, I saw it first.
This meat must be salted quickly.
My inventory just gained one more entry.
Something is on the ground, I always pick it up.

lines.zh: 那是什么声音，我去看看
lines.en: What was that sound, I will take a look.
Someone is approaching the storage room.
Zombies are here, ring the bell quickly.
I saw a shadow among the trees.
Iron golem, over here, come quickly.
Do not leave yet, help me watch.
Those are not a villager's footsteps.
Something moves at the door, I will ask.
This smells like rotten flesh, something is wrong.

lines.zh: 我得先把孩子们叫回屋
lines.en: First I must call the children inside.
Do not come closer, I have nothing here.
I have marked where you stand.
You keep coming closer, step back.
The bell is right beside my hand.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，但会喊人
lines.en: I cannot fight, but I can shout for help.
Something about your smell is wrong.

lines.zh: 这扇门我会从里面顶住
lines.en: I will brace this door from inside.
The whole village is watching you.

lines.zh: 你在我的铺子前转了三圈
lines.en: You circled my stall three times.
The golem is faster than me, just wait.
I can fight with a rolling pin too.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了我的萝卜
lines.en: This blow is for my carrots.
Keep your hands off my counter.
I swing this sack of flour at you.
One move is all I have, and it works.
After this fight I still have a shop to open.
My fists are softer than the golem's.
Back off, I am going to shout for help.
This one goes on your account.
I cannot beat you, but I will not run.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我该开门做生意
lines.en: Daylight is here, I should open my shop.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有床，我就住这
lines.en: This house has a bed, so I live here.
Newcomers have gathered at the meeting point.
I woke up the entire street.

lines.zh: 门口的招牌我亲手挂上
lines.en: I hung the sign by the door myself.

lines.zh: 从今天起我有了自己的职业
lines.en: Starting today I have a profession of my own.
The village needs hands, so here I am.

lines.zh: 早晨的第一声铃是我敲的
lines.en: I rang the first bell of the morning.

lines.zh: 我数了数，村里多了三张床
lines.en: I counted three new beds in the village.

lines.zh: 这扇门后面就是我的家
lines.en: My home is right behind this door.
My robe is not fireproof.
Even the stone road is not that flat.
I cannot swim, truly I cannot.
Half the house is down, and my goods.

lines.zh: 谁在远处放箭，这不讲规矩
lines.en: Who shoots arrows from afar, no manners.
That purple light, do not point it at me.
Bread costs more, and I still go hungry.
The lightning rod sits atop the bell tower.

lines.zh: 村子在上面，我掉进什么了
lines.en: My village is above, what did I fall into?
